text:
Hector Martinez: FYI Lumina-ML sent invoice LUM-9001 for $24,300 but no PO on PDF. They say this is the quarterly support retainer and need payment within 7 days per contract.
Leah O'Connor: Do we have a standing PO for Lumina? Which internal owner?
Mina Kapoor: Procurement created PO-8319 for Lumina last year but that's a blanket PO for licensing, not support. Might be PO-8540 for Platform ops.
Paul Gomez: Coupa auto-match failed. APBot flagged: NO_PO_MATCH and PAYMENT_HOLD.
APBot: Invoice LUM-9001 flagged. Status: PAYMENT_HOLD. AP ticket AP-54877 opened. Required approvers: Paul Gomez (Infra lead), Leah O'Connor (Procurement), FinanceOpsBot (FP&A review).
Hector Martinez: Vendor emailed legal contract clause referencing "auto-renewal and 30-day net". They say late fees start day 8.
Mina Kapoor: If it's a support retainer it should hit cost center 240-PLAT and GL 6200. We need owner approval to allow override.
Paul Gomez: I can approve the functional charge but FP&A needs to confirm cash timing. @FinanceOpsBot please check cash window.
FinanceOpsBot: FP&A note: cash available, but we require confirmation of correct PO mapping or one-time exception reason. Suggested note: "vendor billed support retainer; PO mapping ambiguous; one-time override to avoid service disruption".
Leah O'Connor: Procurement: Lumina should have PO-8540 for Platform support. Vendor probably used old billing template and omitted the PO number. I approve routing to AP for override if FP&A signs.
Paul Gomez: Approve override. Add requirement: vendor must reissue future invoices with PO-8540 and updated billing contact.
APBot: Required approvals recorded. PAYMENT_HOLD cleared. Payment scheduled on next run 2026-04-08. AP ticket AP-54877 updated with follow-up: confirm reissued invoice and update vendor billing template.
Hector Martinez: I'll confirm with Lumina and push for reissued invoice referencing PO-8540. Also asked them to provide a remit-to bank confirmation.
Mina Kapoor: Please also attach the contract clause to AP ticket so procurement can audit blanket PO usage.
Paul Gomez: Thanks team. Leah, close AP-54877 after payment posts and vendor reissue is received.
